settings.description: Allow sandboxed processes to open URLs in the host browser. Disabling it also prevents in-sandbox OAuth logins that redirect to localhost.
Allow Claude Code to access host browser tabs through Claude in Chrome.
Allow Claude Code's Remote Control to authenticate with the environment and session credentials the proxy holds on the host.
Allow sandboxed agents to read the host clipboard for image paste (Ctrl+V).
Allow sandboxed processes to copy text to the host clipboard.
Days to keep rotated daemon logs (maximum 3650). 0 keeps them regardless of age, subject to the backup limit.
Number of rotated daemon logs to keep. 0 keeps all, subject to the age limit.
Size in MB at which daemon.log rotates (minimum 1).
Tri-state consent for automatic diagnostics bundle upload on error: "" (never asked; prompts and uploads nothing), "yes" (accepted; upload), "no" (declined; never prompt again).
Maximum outbound connections all sandboxes together can have still connecting at once. Further connections wait for one to finish. 0 removes the limit.
Maximum outbound connections one sandbox can have still connecting at once. Further connections wait for one to finish. 0 removes the limit.

Seconds, up to 3600, an outbound connection can go without the remote end acknowledging data before it is closed, so a connection stranded by a network change such as a VPN connecting fails instead of hanging. 0 turns this off. Changes apply to new sandboxes, and to existing ones after the daemon restarts.
Let an approval of an environment's host commands cover later runs of the same commands, instead of asking each time.
Enables the claude-bedrock agent. Experimental — gated by platform.allowExperimentalFeatures.
Enables the claude-vertex agent. Experimental — gated by platform.allowExperimentalFeatures.
Shows the commit-signing key commands (sbx setup ssh-key) and configures git identity and commit signing in new cloud sandboxes. Experimental — gated by platform.allowExperimentalFeatures.
Shows the cloud schedule commands (sbx --cloud schedule). Experimental — gated by platform.allowExperimentalFeatures.
Remote kill switch for automatic diagnostics bundle upload on error. Experimental — gated by platform.allowExperimentalFeatures.

Remote override for the automatic-diagnostics-upload error-category allow-list. Variant payload is a JSON array of category names (or ["*"] for all) that replaces the built-in list. Experimental — gated by platform.allowExperimentalFeatures.

Remote override for the minimum hours between automatic diagnostics uploads. Variant payload is the cooldown in whole hours (base-10 integer, floored at 1) that replaces the built-in default. Experimental — gated by platform.allowExperimentalFeatures.

Remote override for the automatic-diagnostics-upload status-code filter. Variant payload is the minimum status code (decimal) below which an unknown-category error is treated as a client error and skipped. Experimental — gated by platform.allowExperimentalFeatures.
Enables the docker-hub-id-token reserved kit service, injecting the signed-in user's Docker Hub OIDC id_token into a kit's declared inject.domain header. Experimental — off by default.
Enables the Gordon TUI assistant. Experimental — gated by platform.allowExperimentalFeatures.
Enables the AI Governance upsell banner in the TUI. Experimental — gated by platform.allowExperimentalFeatures.
Legacy GUI rollout flag; automatic launch is disabled regardless of this value.
Enables `sbx run --model` to serve a local GGUF model via llmman (or a real Ollama install) and route an agent's API calls to it. Experimental — gated by platform.allowExperimentalFeatures.
Enables sandbox profiles. Experimental — gated by platform.allowExperimentalFeatures.
Serve the /v0 public API from sandboxd; takes effect at daemon start. Experimental — gated by platform.allowExperimentalFeatures.
Enables the --4k flag for forcing the 4k-page guest kernel. Experimental — gated by platform.allowExperimentalFeatures.
Enables the --display flag for wayland display surfaces. Experimental — gated by platform.allowExperimentalFeatures.
Enables the --gpu flag for GPU passthrough. Experimental — gated by platform.allowExperimentalFeatures.
Enables the --usb flag for USB device passthrough. Experimental — gated by platform.allowExperimentalFeatures.
Enables the native SSH server in sandboxd. Experimental — gated by platform.allowExperimentalFeatures.
Sends verified sandbox identity to compatible host SSH agents. Experimental — gated by platform.allowExperimentalFeatures.
Enables policy-controlled outbound UDP associations. Experimental — gated by platform.allowExperimentalFeatures.
Allow installing kits from local directories or ZIP files. Set to false to require a remote source.
JSON array of allowed kit source prefixes (e.g. ["docker.io/", "ghcr.io/docker/"]). Use ["*"] to allow any remote source.
Verify keyless kit signatures without requiring a Rekor transparency-log entry (for private kits signed with --tlog-upload=false).
Require a valid signature from a trusted signer (kit.trustedSigners) before installing a kit.

Kit reference (registry reference, oci:// or git+ URL, or absolute path) that `sbx run claude` and `sbx create claude` resolve instead of the default kit for claude. Applies to local sandboxes only. Unset to restore the default.

Kit reference (registry reference, oci:// or git+ URL, or absolute path) that `sbx run claude-bedrock` and `sbx create claude-bedrock` resolve instead of the default kit for claude-bedrock. Applies to local sandboxes only. Unset to restore the default.

Kit reference (registry reference, oci:// or git+ URL, or absolute path) that `sbx run claude-vertex` and `sbx create claude-vertex` resolve instead of the default kit for claude-vertex. Applies to local sandboxes only. Unset to restore the default.

Kit reference (registry reference, oci:// or git+ URL, or absolute path) that `sbx run codex` and `sbx create codex` resolve instead of the default kit for codex. Applies to local sandboxes only. Unset to restore the default.

Kit reference (registry reference, oci:// or git+ URL, or absolute path) that `sbx run copilot` and `sbx create copilot` resolve instead of the default kit for copilot. Applies to local sandboxes only. Unset to restore the default.

Kit reference (registry reference, oci:// or git+ URL, or absolute path) that `sbx run cursor` and `sbx create cursor` resolve instead of the default kit for cursor. Applies to local sandboxes only. Unset to restore the default.

Kit reference (registry reference, oci:// or git+ URL, or absolute path) that `sbx run devin` and `sbx create devin` resolve instead of the default kit for devin. Applies to local sandboxes only. Unset to restore the default.

Kit reference (registry reference, oci:// or git+ URL, or absolute path) that `sbx run docker-agent` and `sbx create docker-agent` resolve instead of the default kit for docker-agent. Applies to local sandboxes only. Unset to restore the default.

Kit reference (registry reference, oci:// or git+ URL, or absolute path) that `sbx run droid` and `sbx create droid` resolve instead of the default kit for droid. Applies to local sandboxes only. Unset to restore the default.

Kit reference (registry reference, oci:// or git+ URL, or absolute path) that `sbx run kiro` and `sbx create kiro` resolve instead of the default kit for kiro. Applies to local sandboxes only. Unset to restore the default.

Kit reference (registry reference, oci:// or git+ URL, or absolute path) that `sbx run opencode` and `sbx create opencode` resolve instead of the default kit for opencode. Applies to local sandboxes only. Unset to restore the default.

Kit reference (registry reference, oci:// or git+ URL, or absolute path) that `sbx run shell` and `sbx create shell` resolve instead of the default kit for shell. Applies to local sandboxes only. Unset to restore the default.
JSON array of trusted signer policies (key-based {"key":path} or keyless {"issuer":...,"identity":...}). Defaults to Docker employee identities (*@docker.com via https://accounts.google.com).
Force the local MCP gateway even when entitled to the SaaS gateway.

Prefix MCP tool names with their server name ("<server-name>-<tool-name>"), for --static-mcp servers and servers attached via the in-process `mcp-add` agent tool or `sbx mcp load`. Reaches local direct backends only; hosted/SaaS control-plane remotes are not yet covered. Recorded as a create-time gateway choice: toggling it does not rename tools in an already-created sandbox's gateway, including across a bare reattach; only a newly created gateway picks up the current value.

JSON object of inference endpoints for `sbx run --model <model> --provider <id>`, keyed by id, e.g. {"gpubox": {"url": "http://gpubox:8000/v1"}}. Fields: url (required, absolute http(s)), wire ("openai" default or "anthropic"), apiKeyEnv (variable llmman serve reads the API key from), name.

Run the bundled llmman model server when the daemon starts. `sbx run --model` needs it, except with `--provider ollama`. llmman downloads its inference runtime from the network when it starts; set false to stop it starting after the next daemon restart.
No-proxy exception list for sandbox, daemon, and supported CLI host egress (comma-separated hosts, domain suffixes, and CIDRs).
No-proxy exception list for daemon and supported CLI host egress (overrides no_proxy).
No-proxy exception list for sandbox egress only (overrides no_proxy).
Allow experimental features.

Registry mirror host for Docker Hub-resolving template and kit images (e.g. "artifactory.corp/docker-remote"). A bare host that is not a loopback or wildcard address also mirrors Docker Hub pulls made inside the sandbox, provided the sandbox trusts its certificate. Empty disables mirroring.
Use Docker Hardened Image (DHI) equivalents (dhi/sbx-templates) for agent template images.
Upstream proxy for sandbox, daemon, and supported CLI host egress (URL, PAC source, "system", or "direct"; empty = automatic: HTTP(S)_PROXY if set, otherwise the host OS proxy).
Upstream proxy for daemon and supported CLI host egress (overrides proxy).
Enable integrated NTLM/Kerberos authentication (Windows SSPI) for sandbox, daemon, and supported CLI host egress.
Upstream proxy for sandbox egress only (overrides proxy).
Dial the cloud SSH gateway directly instead of through the proxy selected for CLI host egress.

Size of a sandbox's /var/lib/docker volume (minimum 512 MiB; e.g. "10g"). Applies to sandboxes created after the change; existing volumes are never resized. Set DOCKER_SANDBOXES_DOCKER_SIZE to override one sandbox.

Expose /dev/fuse and grant SYS_ADMIN for mounting FUSE filesystems in new local sandboxes. An environment file can disable access for one sandbox. Changes affect only newly created sandboxes; existing sandboxes retain their configuration. Unsupported by the experimental Runtime backend.

Default for an omitted --skills flag or sbx.yaml `skills:` key: "off", "readonly", or "readwrite". Applies to sandboxes created after the change; existing sandboxes' mounts are never retroactively changed.

Allow sandboxes to list SSH agent keys and sign, but not add, remove or lock keys. Disabling blocks new agent connections; existing connections remain active. After enabling, restart the daemon, then restart sandboxes that started with forwarding disabled.

Optional fixed host SSH agent socket path. Empty uses each client's current SSH_AUTH_SOCK, or the native Windows OpenSSH agent pipe when that variable is unset. Existing forwarders require a daemon restart after changes.
Create a sandbox on SSH connect when it does not exist.
Built-in agent used for SSH auto-created sandboxes.
Template image override for SSH auto-created sandboxes (agent default if empty).
Host directory holding SSH auto-created sandbox workspaces (empty = mount-less, container-internal).
Disable telemetry. SBX_NO_TELEMETRY=1 also disables telemetry.
Accept server certificates with a negative serial number (needed by some TLS-inspecting proxies).
Offer post-quantum (ML-KEM) key exchange in TLS connections. Turn off if a firewall or TLS-inspecting proxy drops sbx's connections.
Names the update channel a user follows, via its variant. Experimental — gated by platform.allowExperimentalFeatures.

This is a plain shell sandbox on DHI: bash, git, apt, a Docker
engine (compose/buildx) that sbx starts for you, curl, gh, jq,
make, and Python 3 with pip and uv. This kit ships no network
policy of its own: outbound access, including the apt sources
(deb.debian.org, dhi.io), is whatever the sandbox policy and
composed kits allow. Install more with apt where that permits;
composed kits list their own capabilities below.

Create a sandbox on SSH connect when it does not exist.
